title: Screen Owner
empty: No keyboards or mice found. Is the daemon running?
single_monitor: Only one monitor is connected — nothing to switch to, assignments are kept.
access_why: Some devices have no permissions. A udev rule is needed, and it is written as root.
tip_row: Click for the next monitor, right-click to pick one
err_timeout: The daemon did not answer in time
err_bad_json: Could not parse the daemon's answer
err_access: Granting access failed — check the privilege command setting

command.label: Daemon command
command.description: Path to screen-owner. The panel calls it with devices, monitors and assign.

privilege_command.label: Privilege command
privilege_command.description: How to install the udev rule: pkexec or sudo. Asked once, on the first grant.

autostart.label: Start with the session
autostart.description: Launch the daemon when noctalia starts. Turn off to keep a line in hyprland.lua or start it by hand.

setup_why: This plugin is only a panel. For it to have something to talk to, these are missing:
missing_evdev: • python-evdev — the daemon is written in it
installed: All set, the daemon is running
err_no_source: screen-owner.py is missing from the plugin directory
err_chmod: Could not make the daemon executable
err_pacman: pacman failed — check the privilege command in settings
